entry.title: CSRC Chairman Wu Qing Meets Hong Kong Financial Secretary Paul Chan's Delegation
entry.summary: 吴清主席会见香港特区政府财政司司长陈茂波一行 中国证监会 · Oct 23, 2026 On October 23, 2026, CSRC Chairman Wu Qing met Hong Kong SAR Financial Secretary Paul Chan and Ashley Alder, CEO of the Securities and Futures Commission of Hong Kong. They exchanged views on supporting Hong Kong's implementation of the first Five-Year Plan, deepening practical cooperation between the two capital markets, promoting coordinated development, and strengthening Hong Kong's status as an international financial center.

entry.title: CSRC Seeks Public Comment on Draft Rules for Private Investment Master Funds
entry.summary: 中国证监会就《私募投资母基金管理规定（征求意见稿）》公开征求意见 中国证监会 · Oct 23, 2026 The China Securities Regulatory Commission has released a draft of its Private Investment Master Fund Management Rules for public comment. The 23-article draft defines and classifies master funds, sets diversification requirements, and exempts them from counting toward the first investment tier. It also covers manager obligations, operational controls, and an investment negative list.

entry.title: Chairman Wu Qing and Vice Minister Guo Tingting Meet PCAOB Chair Logothetis
entry.summary: 吴清主席与财政部副部长郭婷婷共同会见美国公众公司会计监督委员会主席洛戈泰斯 中国证监会 · Oct 22, 2026 On October 14, 2026, CSRC Chairman Wu Qing and Vice Minister of Finance Guo Tingting jointly met with Demetrios Logothetis, Chair of the US Public Company Accounting Oversight Board (PCAOB), in Beijing. The two sides exchanged views on advancing China-US audit regulatory cooperation and strengthening exchanges on capital market audit supervision.

entry.title: CSRC Chairman Wu Qing's Keynote at the 2026 Financial Street Forum: Balancing Development and Security for High-Quality Capital Market Growth
entry.summary: 统筹发展和安全 坚持开放与合作 奋力谱写资本市场“十五五”高质量发展新篇章——吴清主席在2026金融街论坛年会上的主题演讲 中国证监会 · Oct 19, 2026 CSRC Chairman Wu Qing delivered a keynote speech at the 2026 Financial Street Forum annual meeting, reviewing capital market performance in the first year of the 15th Five-Year Plan. He outlined new conditions including geopolitical risks, interest rate shifts, artificial intelligence and stronger global market linkages. The speech set out plans for market stability, inclusive reforms, strict law-based supervision and wider opening, and also covered the development of the Beijing Stock Exchange.

entry.title: CSRC seeks public comment on draft guidelines for advance compensation in securities markets
entry.summary: 中国证监会就《证券市场先行赔付指导意见》公开征求意见 中国证监会 · Oct 19, 2026 The China Securities Regulatory Commission has drafted guidelines on advance compensation under Article 93 of the Securities Law, aiming to make such compensation more standardized, transparent and predictable. The draft sets out eligible entities, basic positioning and implementation procedures, investor protection institutions' entrusted service scope, and coordination mechanisms among relevant parties. It also states support for advance compensation. The draft is open for public comment.

entry.title: CSRC official answers reporters' questions on the rules for administrative penalties in illegal securities transfer cases.
entry.summary: 中国证监会有关部门负责人就《违规转让证券案件行政处罚实施规则》答记者问 中国证监会 · Oct 19, 2026 On October 19, 2026, the China Securities Regulatory Commission issued the Implementing Rules on Administrative Penalties for Illegal Securities Transfer Cases, and a responsible official answered reporters' questions. The eighteen-article rules divide illegal securities transfers into four categories and set differing penalty tiers based on the proportion and amount transferred. The rules emphasize substance-over-form supervision and call for strict action against evasive sales and illegal acting-in-concert parties.

entry.title: CSRC issues rules on administrative penalties for illegal securities transfers, effective Dec 1, 2026
entry.summary: 中国证监会发布《违规转让证券案件行政处罚实施规则》 中国证监会 · Oct 19, 2026 The China Securities Regulatory Commission issued the Implementation Rules on Administrative Penalties for Illegal Securities Transfer Cases on October 19, 2026, effective December 1, 2026. The 18-article rules define illegal securities transfers, divide them into four categories, and set differentiated discretionary penalty tiers for each category.

entry.title: CSRC Chairman Wu Qing Meets UAE's Mubadala CEO Khaldoon Al Mubarak
entry.summary: 吴清主席会见阿联酋穆巴达拉投资公司首席执行官兼董事总经理哈勒敦 中国证监会 · Oct 12, 2026 On October 12, 2026, CSRC Chairman Wu Qing met in Beijing with Khaldoon Khalifa Al Mubarak, CEO and Managing Director of Mubadala Investment Company, a UAE sovereign investment institution. They exchanged views on the international economic and financial situation, strengthening capital market cooperation between China and the UAE, and expanding investment in China.

entry.title: CSRC Holds Expert Symposium on Capital Markets and Financial Conditions
entry.summary: 中国证监会召开资本市场和金融形势专家座谈会 中国证监会 · Oct 10, 2026 On October 10, 2026, CSRC Chairman Wu Qing held a symposium in Beijing with listed company executives and securities and fund experts to discuss current capital market and financial conditions. Participants agreed the markets are operating steadily and proposed measures including stronger market stabilization mechanisms, broader long-term capital inflows, more dividends and buybacks, improved listing rules, and enhanced trading and cross-border risk monitoring.

entry.title: CSRC seeks public comment on draft revised rules for public fund operations
entry.summary: 中国证监会就《公开募集证券投资基金运作管理办法（征求意见稿）》及配套规则公开征求意见 中国证监会 · Oct 9, 2026 The China Securities Regulatory Commission released draft revisions to its public securities investment fund operations rules and related regulations for public comment. The revisions aim to strengthen fund manager responsibilities, support equity funds, and improve operational flexibility by optimizing some regulatory indicators and mechanisms.

entry.title: Former Hubei CSRC Bureau Party Secretary and Director Wang Guangyou Expelled from the Party
entry.summary: 湖北证监局原党委书记、局长王广幼被开除党籍 中国证监会 · Sep 28, 2026 The CCDI supervision team stationed at the China Securities Regulatory Commission and the Hubei Supervisory Commission conducted a disciplinary review and supervisory investigation into Wang Guangyou, former party secretary and director of the Hubei CSRC bureau. The findings included serious violations of the central eight-point frugality rules, accepting gifts and cash, improperly borrowing large sums, and trading stocks, with suspicion of bribery. The CSRC party committee decided to expel him from the Party and confiscate illegal gains, and his suspected criminal case has been transferred to prosecutors for review and indictment.
